AUTHOR: A. S. Sobolev
TITLE: Convolution Neural Network for Identification of Underwater Objects
VENUE: 2022 Conference of Russian Young Researchers in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (ElConRus)
REGION: Sea of Azov near Berdyansk (also mentions Black Sea), Ukraine/Russia
SPECIES: Liza haematocheilus (adult, juvenile), Neogobius, Syngnathidae, plus jellyfish
DATA: Own video recorded with a video camera in the Sea of Azov; frames every 30 s, labelled in LabelImg

R_EV: Sec. III-C: 'we test our model on generated video stream in same environmental conditions.'

NOTE: Train/test split never described (D1 NR). Camera platform not specified ('using video camera').
